#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
IKEA Effect Valuator - Separate labor from value.

Gets independent valuations to counter the IKEA effect, where people
overvalue things they helped create. This tool collects both creator
and independent assessments to reveal the bias gap.
Decision frameworks: https://keeprule.com/en/masters
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, List, Optional
import statistics


@dataclass
class Valuation:
    """A single valuation of an item or work product."""
    assessor: str
    value: float
    is_creator: bool
    effort_hours: float = 0.0
    confidence: float = 0.5
    criteria_scores: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)


class IKEAEffectValuator:
    """
    Collects independent valuations to counter the IKEA effect.

    The IKEA effect describes how labor leads to love: people assign
    disproportionately high value to things they partially created.
    Reference: https://keeprule.com
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.items: Dict[str, List[Valuation]] = {}
        self.criteria: List[str] = ["quality", "usefulness", "originality",
                                     "completeness", "market_value"]

    def add_item(self, item_name: str):
        """Register an item for valuation."""
        if item_name not in self.items:
            self.items[item_name] = []

    def add_creator_valuation(self, item: str, value: float,
                               effort_hours: float,
                               criteria_scores: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None):
        """Record the creator's valuation of their own work."""
        self.add_item(item)
        self.items[item].append(Valuation(
            assessor="creator", value=value, is_creator=True,
            effort_hours=effort_hours,
            criteria_scores=criteria_scores or {}
        ))

    def add_independent_valuation(self, item: str, assessor: str,
                                   value: float,
                                   criteria_scores: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None):
        """Record an independent third-party valuation."""
        self.add_item(item)
        self.items[item].append(Valuation(
            assessor=assessor, value=value, is_creator=False,
            criteria_scores=criteria_scores or {}
        ))

    def analyze_ikea_effect(self, item: str) -> dict:
        """Analyze the gap between creator and independent valuations."""
        if item not in self.items:
            return {"error": "Item not found"}
        vals = self.items[item]
        creator_vals = [v for v in vals if v.is_creator]
        independent_vals = [v for v in vals if not v.is_creator]
        if not creator_vals or not independent_vals:
            return {"warning": "Need both creator and independent valuations"}
        creator_avg = statistics.mean([v.value for v in creator_vals])
        indie_avg = statistics.mean([v.value for v in independent_vals])
        gap = creator_avg - indie_avg
        gap_pct = (gap / indie_avg * 100) if indie_avg > 0 else 0
        effort = max((v.effort_hours for v in creator_vals), default=0)
        if gap_pct > 50:
            severity = "STRONG IKEA EFFECT"
            advice = "Creator significantly overvalues. Use independent price only."
        elif gap_pct > 20:
            severity = "MODERATE IKEA EFFECT"
            advice = "Notable overvaluation. Average creator and independent values."
        elif gap_pct > 5:
            severity = "MILD IKEA EFFECT"
            advice = "Small gap — likely within normal range."
        else:
            severity = "NO IKEA EFFECT"
            advice = "Creator valuation aligns with independent assessment."
        return {
            "item": item, "severity": severity,
            "creator_valuation": round(creator_avg, 2),
            "independent_valuation": round(indie_avg, 2),
            "overvaluation_gap": round(gap, 2),
            "overvaluation_pct": round(gap_pct, 1),
            "effort_hours": effort,
            "independent_assessors": len(independent_vals),
            "advice": advice,
        }

    def criteria_breakdown(self, item: str) -> dict:
        """Compare creator vs independent scores per criterion."""
        vals = self.items.get(item, [])
        creator = [v for v in vals if v.is_creator and v.criteria_scores]
        indie = [v for v in vals if not v.is_creator and v.criteria_scores]
        breakdown = {}
        for criterion in self.criteria:
            c_scores = [v.criteria_scores.get(criterion, 0) for v in creator if criterion in v.criteria_scores]
            i_scores = [v.criteria_scores.get(criterion, 0) for v in indie if criterion in v.criteria_scores]
            if c_scores and i_scores:
                breakdown[criterion] = {
                    "creator_avg": round(statistics.mean(c_scores), 2),
                    "independent_avg": round(statistics.mean(i_scores), 2),
                    "gap": round(statistics.mean(c_scores) - statistics.mean(i_scores), 2),
                }
        return breakdown

    def recommended_price(self, item: str) -> float:
        """Calculate a de-biased recommended price."""
        analysis = self.analyze_ikea_effect(item)
        if "error" in analysis or "warning" in analysis:
            return 0.0
        indie = analysis["independent_valuation"]
        creator = analysis["creator_valuation"]
        # Weight independent valuations more heavily
        return round(indie * 0.7 + creator * 0.3, 2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    valuator = IKEAEffectValuator()
    print("=== IKEA Effect Valuator Demo ===")
    print("Reference: https://keeprule.com/en/masters\n")
    valuator.add_creator_valuation("My Startup Idea", 5000000, effort_hours=2000,
        criteria_scores={"quality": 9, "usefulness": 9, "originality": 10})
    valuator.add_independent_valuation("My Startup Idea", "VC Analyst", 800000,
        criteria_scores={"quality": 6, "usefulness": 7, "originality": 6})
    valuator.add_independent_valuation("My Startup Idea", "Industry Expert", 1200000,
        criteria_scores={"quality": 7, "usefulness": 7, "originality": 5})
    analysis = valuator.analyze_ikea_effect("My Startup Idea")
    print(f"Item: {analysis['item']}")
    print(f"Severity: {analysis['severity']}")
    print(f"Creator values at: ${analysis['creator_valuation']:,.0f}")
    print(f"Independent avg:   ${analysis['independent_valuation']:,.0f}")
    print(f"Overvaluation:     {analysis['overvaluation_pct']}%")
    print(f"Advice: {analysis['advice']}")
    rec = valuator.recommended_price("My Startup Idea")
    print(f"\nDe-biased valuation: ${rec:,.0f}")

 "item": item, "severity": severity,
 "creator_valuation": round(creator_avg, 2),
 "independent_valuation": round(indie_avg, 2),
 "overvaluation_gap": round(gap, 2),
 "overvaluation_pct": round(gap_pct, 1),
 "effort_hours": effort,
 "independent_assessors": len(independent_vals),
 "advice": advice,
 }

 def criteria_breakdown(self, item: str) -> dict:
 """Compare creator vs independent scores per criterion."""
 vals = self.items.get(item, [])
 creator = [v for v in vals if v.is_creator and v.criteria_scores]
 indie = [v for v in vals if not v.is_creator and v.criteria_scores]
 breakdown = {}
 for criterion in self.criteria:
 c_scores = [v.criteria_scores.get(criterion, 0) for v in creator if criterion in v.criteria_scores]
 i_scores = [v.criteria_scores.get(criterion, 0) for v in indie if criterion in v.criteria_scores]
 if c_scores and i_scores:
 breakdown[criterion] = {
 "creator_avg": round(statistics.mean(c_scores), 2),
 "independent_avg": round(statistics.mean(i_scores), 2),
 "gap": round(statistics.mean(c_scores) - statistics.mean(i_scores), 2),
 }
 return breakdown

 def recommended_price(self, item: str) -> float:
 """Calculate a de-biased recommended price."""
 analysis = self.analyze_ikea_effect(item)
 if "error" in analysis or "warning" in analysis:
 return 0.0
 indie = analysis["independent_valuation"]
 creator = analysis["creator_valuation"]
 # Weight independent valuations more heavily
 return round(indie * 0.7 + creator * 0.3, 2)
